svg.text: A Workshop & Accelerator for Constructing Reliable, Production-Grade Agentic Systems
Intent Classification constrains routing to 7 predefined
intents each routing to a specialized domain agent
Each intent authorizes a fixed set of allowed agents. The
model will not reach an agent outside of that set.
Only first step, Intent Classification, accepts
unstructured text; every hop after accepts only
Prompting is explicitly templated with locked
The model selects one agent per step; code-based
gates enforce allow-list business rules, and caps
Read-only: Only SELECT statements reach the database
Writes are not allowed - enforced outside the
The model reasons and writes the answer.
Routing, validation, and security are all code.
Two feeds in: Execution Trace panel + the answer.
Read/answer path → Orchestrator (ReAct); /crews & /events too. Injects MCP Tools.
See the deterministic write path (lower left).
classify → reason → compose. Owns no domain logic.
Every path out emits a terminal 'final' or 'error' event.
REACT CONTROL LOOP - the Orchestrator runs this
repeats <= 8 - stops on done or no new data - each pass sees prior AgentResults

g.text: Invokes an SLM model call to classify
Call SLM to determine which class to invoke next,
or to stop processing if the request is complete.
Returns class name to Orchestrator inside
DETERMINISTIC WRITE PATH - BYPASSES THE ORCHESTRATOR
No intent classifier, no reasoning, no MCP. Plain REST →
SQLAlchemy session, not MCP. The read path stays read-only;
writes are confined to this service by design.
DATA LEG - HOW ANY DATA AGENT REACHES POSTGRES
One fresh session per call. Streamable HTTP.
SELECT / WITH only · single statement · LIMIT n
Fast-fail convenience - NOT the security boundary.
This + the read-only grant is the real security boundary.
Enforced outside any process the model can influence.
rows → parsed to list[dict] → back up as AgentResult

Model calls: #1 classify intent · #2 decide next agent per step (ReAct) · #3 NL2SQL · #4 narrate answer · #5 (conditional, write path only) outage note-triage. Between them: fixed intent taxonomy, allow-list, 8-step cap, statement checks, write-disabled grant - all code (read path). Outage / generator writes bypass all of this.
